replies.author: Individual-Peak-9586
replies.body:
Even if you're able to make really great pixel art sprite sheets, it becomes a scaling problem very quickly. 

As a solo dev, or someone working in a small team, it could take ungodly amounts of time to make spritesheets for hundreds of npcs/creatures walking in all directions, let alone performing actions like sitting or attacking, changing clothes, etc. 

That's at least 16 sprites per npc/creature just walking (4 sprites in each direction). Multiply that by a variety of actions or even add in diagonal movement, it's so much.

Having AI speed up the process here is a great use of a tool, it just makes sense. You can place in your own art, have it generate the animation, and you just have to retouch it to maintain your color palette/pixel integrity.
